type.description: Contact accounting classification, or null if unset.

isPerson.description: Whether the contact is an individual rather than a company.

createdAt.description: Creation instant normalized to UTC with original fractional precision.

updatedAt.description: Modification instant normalized to UTC with original fractional precision.

customFields.description: Custom field values retaining scalar or string-array types.

value.description: Value returned for the field, without stringification.

items.description: A custom field identifier and its typed value.

billingAddress.description: Billing postal address, preserving null or absent values.

Contacts.description: Contact directory identity, communication details, billing address, classifications and bank/fiscal references.

syncs.name: sync-invoices

lines.description: Ordered line-level monetary and accounting allocations.

price.description: Exact decimal unit price in invoice currency.

weight.description: Exact decimal weight in account default units; unit is not inferred.

supplied.description: Supply expense excluded from tax base and posted to account 555.

items.description: An ordered invoice line with monetary and accounting allocations.

total.description: Exact final amount including taxes and discounts.

status.description: Stored payment status; not an inferred overdue status.

currency.description: Currency of all document monetary totals.

discount.description: Provider total-discount decimal value with no inferred unit conversion.

subtotal.description: Exact decimal subtotal before taxes and discounts.

contactId.description: Live associated contact identifier, or null.

contactName.description: Contact display name, possibly retained after contact deletion.

Invoices.description: Sales-invoice receivables, calendar dates, balances, tags and ordered line allocations.

functions.name: create-contact
functions.description: Create a person or company with communication, billing, bank, fiscal and default-document settings.

name.description: Full legal name of the person or company.

tags.description: Contact tags; [] explicitly supplies no tags.

type.description: Contact classification; omission creates an unclassified contact.

emails.description: Ordered email addresses: first primary, remaining additional. Provider ignores invalid addresses and rejects a nonempty list with none valid. Null or [] requests no addresses.

items.description: One email address without comma or semicolon delimiters.

defaults.description: Defaults for new documents for this contact; omitted leaves provider defaults.

dueDays.description: Default number of days until payment is due.

numberingSeries.description: Document-type to numbering-series ID map. order means purchase order; proform means proforma. Unrecognized IDs are silently stored as null.

additionalProperties.description: Numbering-series identifier, or null for none.

isPerson.description: True for an individual, false for a company; omission uses provider default.

taxNumber.description: Tax identification number; omitted uses the provider default.

customFields.description: Custom fields with scalar values; omission uses provider defaults.

value.description: Typed scalar custom field value or null.

items.description: A custom field and its typed scalar value.

taxOperation.description: Fiscal operation key defined by this account's tax scheme.

billingAddress.description: Billing postal address, or null for none.

clientAccountNumber.description: Numeric chart-of-accounts code for client transactions.

supplierAccountNumber.description: Numeric chart-of-accounts code for supplier transactions.

FunctionInput_holded_v2_createcontact.description: A new person or company contact and optional communication, billing, bank, fiscal and document settings.

id.description: Identifier assigned to the newly created contact.

FunctionOutput_holded_v2_createcontact.description: The created contact identifier; does not confirm retention of every submitted setting.

tags.instructions: Use to create a new contact; use `list-contacts` first if avoiding duplicates matters. Use `update-contact` for an existing contact. The returned ID can be passed directly to `create-invoice`. Invalid numbering-series IDs may be silently stored as null; inspect with `get-contact` when those settings matter.

functions.name: create-invoice
functions.description: Create a sales invoice for an existing contact with priced or title lines, taxes, numbering, shipping and accounting choices.

body.description: Rich-text content printed on the invoice, supplied as ordinary text markup.

date.description: Issue calendar date; omission uses the provider default.

type.description: Line kind; title has no amount. Omit for an ordinary priced line.

price.description: Unit price in invoice currency; supplied values are not loaded from productId.

taxes.description: Tax keys. Omission applies contact defaults, or no tax if none; [] explicitly supplies no keys.

weight.description: Weight in the account default unit.

account.description: Accounting account code for the line.

supplied.description: True for a supply expense paid on behalf of the client, excluded from the tax base.

productId.description: Existing product reference; does not populate line prices or taxes.

retention.description: IRPF withholding percentage reducing the total.

serviceId.description: Existing service reference; when set, provider forces line type service.

variantId.description: Variant reference; non-null requires a non-null productId.

items.description: An invoice priced line or section title.

lines.description: Ordered invoice lines; locally capped at 100 per invocation pending validation.

dueDate.description: Payment due calendar date, or null.

currency.description: Invoice currency code; omission uses provider defaults.

discount.description: Global discount percentage, not a monetary amount.

value.description: Text value for the custom field.

currencyChange.description: Exchange rate when currency differs from account currency.

documentNumber.description: Manual number saved as-is and overriding numberingSeriesId; avoid active series formats.

shippingAddress.description: Shipping mode and address. Omission leaves unset; null clears. Manual fields are ignored for other modes.

type.description: Manual address, contact billing address, no displayed address, or saved contact address.

contactAddressId.description: Saved contact shipping ID, required for contact mode; get it from get-contact.

numberingSeriesId.description: Recommended numbering-series identifier for the next correlative number.

FunctionInput_holded_v2_createinvoice.description: Create one sales invoice for an existing contact with explicit line and document choices.

id.description: Identifier assigned to the newly created sales invoice; does not establish delivery, approval or payment.

FunctionOutput_holded_v2_createinvoice.description: The identifier of the created sales invoice.

tags.instructions: Obtain contactId from `list-contacts`, `search-contacts` or `create-contact`. Provide actual line prices and taxes: linking a product does not populate its values. Prefer numberingSeriesId; a custom documentNumber must not collide with active numbering-series formats. The invoice is normally draft but account auto-approval can apply. This tool does not email or collect payment. Use `get-invoice` to inspect the result before considering a retry.

functions.name: delete-contact
functions.description: Permanently delete a contact and remove its live associations from existing documents, which retain its display name.

contactId.description: Identifier of the contact to delete permanently.

FunctionInput_holded_v2_deletecontact.description: The contact targeted for permanent deletion.

id.description: Identifier targeted by the successful deletion.

deleted.description: True only after the provider acknowledges deletion.

FunctionOutput_holded_v2_deletecontact.description: Acknowledgement of a successful permanent contact deletion.

tags.instructions: Get the contact ID from `list-contacts`, `search-contacts`, or `get-contact`. Deletion cannot be undone. Existing documents retain the name but lose the live contact association and can no longer be filtered by that contact. Use `update-contact` to correct details instead.

functions.name: delete-invoice
functions.description: Permanently delete an invoice and its recorded payments without deleting the contact or other documents.

invoiceId.description: Identifier of the invoice to delete permanently, including recorded payments.

FunctionInput_holded_v2_deleteinvoice.description: The single invoice targeted for permanent deletion.

id.description: Identifier targeted by the successful deletion.

deleted.description: True after the provider acknowledges irreversible invoice deletion.

FunctionOutput_holded_v2_deleteinvoice.description: Acknowledgment of successful permanent invoice deletion.

tags.instructions: Obtain invoiceId from `list-invoices`, `search-invoices-by-number` or `get-invoice`. Deletion cannot be undone and also removes recorded payments. The numbering series does not reuse its number. This is not cancellation or a credit note. Use `update-invoice` to correct an invoice instead.

functions.name: get-contact
functions.description: Get a contact's identity, communication details, addresses, accounting settings, notes, and associated people by ID.

contactId.description: Contact identifier returned by contact lookup or creation.

type.description: Accounting classification or null if unset.

customId.description: External reference assigned to the contact.

defaults.description: Settings applied to new documents for the contact.

dueDays.description: Default days until payment is due.

numberingSeries.description: Document-type to numbering-series ID map; provider keys invoice, receipt, salesorder, estimate, order, proform and waybill are preserved.

additionalProperties.description: Numbering-series identifier or null for this document type.

isPerson.description: True for an individual rather than a company.

sepaDate.description: Mandate signing calendar date, without timezone conversion.

createdAt.description: Creation instant normalized to UTC; null remains null.

tradeName.description: Trading name different from the legal name.

updatedAt.description: Last modification instant normalized to UTC.

customFields.description: User-defined field values, retaining their JSON types.

value.description: Scalar, string-array or null custom field value.

taxOperation.description: Fiscal operation key defined by the account tax scheme.

clientAccount.description: Accounting account used when acting as a client.

number.description: Numeric chart-of-accounts code, not a resource ID.

contactPersons.description: Associated people, retaining their returned identifiers and details.

sendDocumentsByDefault.description: Whether documents go to this person by default.

items.description: A person associated with the contact.

supplierAccount.description: Accounting account used when acting as a supplier.

number.description: Numeric chart-of-accounts code, not a resource ID.

shippingAddresses.description: Saved shipping addresses usable when creating invoices.

FunctionOutput_holded_v2_getcontact.description: The detailed contact profile, with only returned optional values.

tags.instructions: Obtain a contact ID from `list-contacts`, `search-contacts`, or `create-contact`. Use this tool for a detailed profile, including saved shipping-address IDs for invoices. Use `update-contact` to change it.

functions.name: get-invoice
functions.description: Get a sales invoice's lines, monetary totals, payment breakdown, shipping configuration and accounting context.

invoiceId.description: Identifier of the invoice to retrieve.

FunctionInput_holded_v2_getinvoice.description: Select one sales invoice by its identifier.

body.description: Printed rich-text content as returned; no transport encoding.

draft.description: Whether the document is a draft, separately from payment status.

lines.description: Invoice line items in returned order.

tax.description: Primary tax percentage as an exact decimal.

price.description: Exact unit price decimal in invoice currency.

weight.description: Decimal weight in the account's default unit; unit not inferred.

account.description: Accounting account code for this line.

supplied.description: Supply expense excluded from the tax base and posted to account 555.

total.description: Exact final decimal amount in invoice currency.

currency.description: ISO currency code for monetary amounts.

discount.description: Provider total-discount decimal value; not assumed to be write-side percentage.

payments.description: Recorded payments; no delivery or settlement promise is added.

bankId.description: Treasury account identifier used for the payment.

subtotal.description: Exact decimal subtotal before tax and discounts.

forecastDate.description: Expected collection calendar date for cash-flow forecasting.

accountingDate.description: Accounting calendar date, possibly different from issue date.

currencyChange.description: Exact decimal exchange rate used by Holded.

sourceDocument.description: Document from which this invoice was created.

amount.description: Exact subtotal allocated to the project.

shippingAddress.description: Shipping mode and manual fields. billing/contact fields may be empty because the address lives on the contact.

contactAddressId.description: Saved contact shipping-address ID for contact mode.

multipleDueDates.description: Split payment schedule, or null if absent.

amount.description: Exact instalment amount in invoice currency.

FunctionOutput_holded_v2_getinvoice.description: Sales invoice details with exact decimal strings, calendar dates, and unresolved shipping references.

tags.instructions: Get the invoice ID from `list-invoices`, `search-invoices-by-number` or `create-invoice`. Use this tool for full details, not number autocomplete. Shipping modes billing and contact point to data on the contact; use `get-contact` with contactId when you need that address. Use `update-invoice` for changes.

functions.name: list-contacts
functions.description: List one page of contacts, optionally matching exact contact details or an external reference.

email.description: Exact email address to match; no normalization is performed.

limit.description: Maximum contacts in this page; explicitly defaults to 25.

phone.description: Exact landline number to match; omitted means no landline filter.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from this tool for the same filters.

mobile.description: Exact mobile number to match; omitted means no mobile filter.

customId.description: Exact external reference stored on the contact.

taxNumber.description: Exact tax identification number, including any punctuation.

FunctionInput_holded_v2_listcontacts.description: Filters and continuation for one page of contact directory entries.

name.description: Legal name of the person or company.

type.description: Accounting classification, or null if unclassified.

customId.description: External reference; null means unset, omission means not supplied.

isPerson.description: True for an individual, false for a company.

extraEmails.description: Additional email addresses, in returned order.

items.description: A contact directory entry without full accounting, address, or note data.
One page of matching contact directory entries in provider order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation; omitted when has_more is false.

FunctionOutput_holded_v2_listcontacts.description: One contact directory page and its optional continuation.

tags.instructions: Use for browsing or exact email, phone, mobile, tax-number, or external-reference matching. Use `search-contacts` for name autocomplete and `get-contact` for a complete profile. Pass nextCursor as cursor with the same filters to continue. Returns at most 100 contacts per call.

functions.name: list-invoices
functions.description: List one page of sales invoices with payment summaries, optional issue/due-date ranges, approval state and accounting-account filters.

sort.description: Issue-date, due-date or total ordering; minus means descending. Omission uses provider order.

limit.description: Maximum invoice summaries in this page; defaults to 50.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation for identical filters and ordering.

status.description: Payment filter. outstanding combines pending and partial; overdue restricts them to past-due invoices.

contactId.description: Filter by an existing contact identifier, obtainable from list-contacts.

dueDateEnd.description: Due-date upper bound; a calendar date includes the entire day, an instant is exact.

issueDateEnd.description: Issue-date upper bound; a calendar date includes the entire day, an instant is exact.

approvalStatus.description: Filter unapproved or approved invoices independently of payment status.

issueDateStart.description: Inclusive issue-date lower bound; omission leaves it unrestricted.

accountingAccountNumber.description: Positive numeric PGC chart-of-accounts code; matches invoices having at least one line booked to it.

FunctionInput_holded_v2_listinvoices.description: Filters, ordering and opaque continuation for one page of sales invoices.

tax.description: Exact decimal tax amount in invoice currency.

total.description: Exact final decimal amount in invoice currency.

status.description: Stored payment status; overdue and outstanding are filters, not stored states.

currency.description: ISO currency code for monetary totals.

discount.description: Provider total-discount decimal value, preserved without inferring an undocumented unit.

subtotal.description: Exact decimal amount before taxes and discounts, in invoice currency.

contactId.description: Live associated contact identifier, or null.

contactName.description: Contact display name, which may survive contact deletion.

paymentsTotal.description: Exact decimal amount already paid, in invoice currency.

paymentsPending.description: Exact decimal remaining balance, in invoice currency.

items.description: A sales invoice summary with available payment balances.
One page of invoice summaries in the requested or provider-default order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation; omitted on the last page.

FunctionOutput_holded_v2_listinvoices.description: One provider page of invoice summaries and its optional continuation.

tags.instructions: Use for browsing invoices, overdue balances, drafts or accounting-account reporting. Use `search-invoices-by-number` for fuzzy document-number lookup and `get-invoice` for complete lines and payment details. Pass nextCursor as cursor with identical filters and sort. Page size is 1–200. Account filters require a numeric PGC code, not an account name.

functions.name: search-contacts
functions.description: Find one page of contacts using token-aware, case- and diacritic-insensitive name-prefix autocomplete.

limit.description: Maximum contacts in this page; defaults to 25.

query.description: Name-prefix search text; token-aware and insensitive to case and diacritics.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation for this same name query.

FunctionInput_holded_v2_searchcontacts.description: Name-prefix autocomplete query and optional page controls.

type.description: Accounting classification, or null if unset.

isPerson.description: Whether this contact is an individual.

items.description: Contact directory entry for full-profile lookup by ID.
One page of matching directory entries, retaining provider order.

nextCursor.description: Continuation for another page; omitted at exhaustion.

FunctionOutput_holded_v2_searchcontacts.description: One page of matching contacts and an optional continuation.

tags.instructions: Use when you have a name or name prefix. Use `list-contacts` for exact email, phone, tax-number or external-reference filters. Use returned IDs with `get-contact`. Continue with nextCursor as cursor and the same query. Maximum page size is 100.

functions.name: search-invoices-by-number
functions.description: Find one relevance-ordered page of non-draft, non-cancelled invoices using fuzzy document-number autocomplete.

limit.description: Maximum matching summaries per page, locally capped at 50 pending validation.

query.description: Document number or prefix to match with provider fuzzy autocomplete.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation for this same number query.

FunctionInput_holded_v2_searchinvoicesby.description: Document-number autocomplete query and optional page controls.

status.description: Stored payment status; cancelled invoices are excluded by this search.

discount.description: Provider total-discount decimal value with no inferred unit conversion.

subtotal.description: Exact pre-tax and pre-discount decimal amount.

documentNumber.description: Actual assigned number; compare it with the query when exact matching matters.

items.description: Invoice summary returned by document-number autocomplete.
One page of fuzzy number matches ordered by provider relevance.

nextCursor.description: Continuation for another match page; omitted at exhaustion.

FunctionOutput_holded_v2_searchinvoicesb.description: One relevance-ordered invoice search page and its optional continuation.

tags.instructions: Use for a document number, prefix, or small typo. Matches are not guaranteed exact or unique; inspect documentNumber before choosing an ID. Draft, deleted and cancelled invoices are excluded; use `list-invoices` for draft or cancelled records. Use `get-invoice` for full details. Continue with nextCursor as cursor and the same query.

functions.name: update-contact
functions.description: Modify selected contact details, document defaults, accounting references or linked contact persons while preserving omitted settings through a read-modify-write.

contactId.description: Identifier of the contact to modify.

tags.description: Complete replacement tags; [] or null requests no tags.

type.description: Accounting classification; null requests no classification.

emails.description: Complete ordered email list, primary first; [] or null clears. Omission preserves primary and additional emails.

items.description: One email address without comma or semicolon separators.

defaults.description: Merge supplied settings; null requests default-setting reset except provider-retained fiscal and numbering settings.

numberingSeries.description: Merge document-type to series-ID settings; null requests clearing all series. Omission preserves existing series; unknown IDs may be stored as null.

additionalProperties.description: Numbering series identifier, or null to clear this document type.

isPerson.description: Whether this is an individual person.

sepaDate.description: Mandate signing date; null clears without timezone conversion.

customFields.description: Complete scalar custom-field replacement; [] or null requests no values.

value.description: Typed scalar field value or null.

taxOperation.description: Account-defined fiscal operation; omission or null keeps its current value and cannot clear it.

billingAddress.description: Merge supplied address children; null clears the full address; {} makes no changes.

countryCode.description: ISO two-letter country code; null clears.

contactPersonIds.description: Complete replacement of linked person contact IDs; [] removes all links. Does not delete the people.

clientAccountNumber.description: Client accounting account numeric code; null requests clearing.

supplierAccountNumber.description: Supplier accounting account numeric code; null requests clearing.

changes.description: Partial changes. Omitted fields are preserved; objects merge by supplied child; arrays replace. Null clears nullable fields except taxOperation, where null preserves.

FunctionInput_holded_v2_updatecontact.description: Contact identifier and selected changes to merge into the current writable contact state.

id.description: Identifier of the contact targeted by the successful update.

status.description: Provider operation status, returned without inventing a status-code interpretation.

FunctionOutput_holded_v2_updatecontact.description: Target contact identifier and the provider update operation status.

tags.instructions: Get the contact ID from `list-contacts` or `search-contacts`. Supply only changes; omitted values are preserved. Arrays you supply replace their entire collection, including contact-person links. This tool reads the current contact before replacing mutable fields, so concurrent edits can be lost. Use `delete-contact` only for irreversible removal.

functions.name: update-invoice
functions.description: Modify selected invoice fields using a guarded read-modify-write; replacing lines does not remove payments already recorded.

lines.description: Complete replacement lines, locally capped at 100; [] requests removing all lines subject to provider validation.

type.description: Line kind, including special-purpose update kinds; omit for an ordinary priced line.

taxes.description: Tax keys; omitted invokes contact defaults, [] supplies no keys.

supplied.description: Supply expense excluded from tax base.

productId.description: Product reference without automatic value lookup.

serviceId.description: Service reference that forces line type service.

variantId.description: Product variant reference; non-null requires a non-null productId.

dueDate.description: Replacement due calendar date; null clears.

currency.description: Invoice currency code; null requests provider reset.

discount.description: Global discount percentage; null requests reset. Not copied blindly from the ambiguous read-side discount value.

language.description: Document language code; null requests reset.

warehouseId.description: Warehouse for stock movements; null clears.

customFields.description: Complete replacement custom field values; [] clears.

shippingAddress.description: Complete replacement shipping configuration; null clears, omission preserves. Manual fields apply only in manual mode.

contactAddressId.description: Saved contact shipping address ID required in contact mode.

numberingSeriesId.description: Numbering-series identifier; omitted preserves when reconstructable, null requests reset.

changes.description: Partial changes; omitted fields preserve current values, arrays replace, shippingAddress replaces as a whole, and nullable nulls request clearing.

FunctionInput_holded_v2_updateinvoice.description: Invoice identifier and selected replacement values for a guarded update.

id.description: Invoice identifier returned by the successfully interpreted update; does not establish that payments changed.

tags.instructions: Obtain invoiceId from `list-invoices` or `search-invoices-by-number`. Supply only changes. Omitted values are preserved where safe reconstruction is possible; supplied lines replace the entire line collection. Existing payments are not changed. Concurrent edits can be overwritten. If safe preservation is impossible, inspect `get-invoice` or edit in Holded rather than retrying blindly.
